# CLODEX Check

> CLODEX Check is an open-source AI API authenticity and protocol checker (AGPL-3.0) hosted at https://check.clodex.xyz.
> In 30–75 seconds it verifies whether an AI API endpoint genuinely passes through Claude, OpenAI (GPT), or Gemini models, or silently swaps/rewraps responses from a cheaper backend.

## Pages

- [Home](https://check.clodex.xyz/): Overview and protocol picker (RU / EN / ZH).
- [Claude API Check](https://check.clodex.xyz/claude): 12 detectors for Anthropic Messages API (`/v1/messages`), anchored by Anthropic server-side `thinking signature` cryptographic verification (Opus 5.5/5/4.8/4.7, Sonnet 5.5/5/4.6, Haiku 5.5/4.5).
- [OpenAI / GPT API Check](https://check.clodex.xyz/openai): 8 detectors for OpenAI Chat Completions (`/v1/chat/completions`), including strict JSON Schema, function calling, streaming parity, token billing, and cross-vendor usage fingerprints (GPT-6.2/6.1/6/5.6/5.5/5.4).
- [Gemini API Check](https://check.clodex.xyz/gemini): 7 detectors for Gemini OpenAI-compatible endpoints (Gemini 4 / 3.8 / 3 / 2.5).
- [FAQ](https://check.clodex.xyz/faq): Practical and technical explanations of detectors, scoring, and API-key privacy.

## Privacy & Security

- API keys live in memory strictly for the duration of a single check job and are discarded immediately afterward.
- Raw keys are never written to disk, logs, report JSON, or databases.
- Public reports display only a masked key prefix/suffix.
- Full source code is public under AGPL-3.0 at https://github.com/mereyabdenbekuly-ctrl/check and can be self-hosted via Python or Docker.
